reviews.title: Don’t
reviews.text:
Let’s be honest, it sounds great, and it does function. But I have a literal ad blocker for my entire phone, and I don’t know. First, what you paste in may or may not be tracked, but considering it sends you the notification for tracking right then, yes. It probaly does. Is it worth it to send a million messages to be tracked? No. Plus, there are many other tools I recommend to easily recreate this effect.
First: use a spammer via Apple shortcuts, like my ReSpam, which you can find on Routinehub for free with no paywalls or tracking.
Second, send a message, copy it every few times, then paste and spam send.
Third, do above on Mac. It’s way easier to do it on a Mac due to the simplicity of keyboard shortcuts, you just spam CMD-V then enter. That simple. Plus this app contains many limits, which is stupid considering it isn’t connected to the cloud, and doesn’t need to by any means.
